cause: N uses a relative axis-height offset. Long family legends increase the axis height, pushing N into the sample labels and next panel titles.
required_fix: Use a fixed point offset below the axis for the N row, then regenerate into a new result directory and review again.
scope: Visual presentation only; independent numerical verification is separate.
